answers.title: 2026 Revival: Why this app now ships with offline fallback
answers.summary: The historical KanZhiHu API is no longer reliable. This build includes bundled content so the app still opens and demonstrates core flows on modern Android.

answers.title: Modernization checklist for legacy Android apps
answers.summary: Raise target SDK, migrate network endpoints to HTTPS, replace brittle globals, and add tests around parser/repository behavior.

answers.title: How to continue from here
answers.summary: Wire a maintained backend to replace bundled data, then incrementally move to AndroidX + modern architecture components.
